subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) XZD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1b9e15ce675b9650b45514d65993cd855ca0c3cf115674054484333ecb257a0.png] 

Option 2) HJN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17abbd69ba25c75692a05e48be4d66fb7e6c43046b17139c90cca8226dab0c73.png] 

**Option 3) EGL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc7b7f583d23764e78e1ffd2fd9f9bd62e06750123d6286db65819b94a56a1ad.png] 

Option 4) SUY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57a5b95b1c1d95f9ccf01119c9f94e337299bf9ecbe991c28bb4bff5d5f3a881.png] 

Here, 'EGL' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
